'''Estoric Sandskimmer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], he and fellow Wraiths [[Hohass Ekwesh]] and [[Voort saBinring]] were sent on a [[Mission to Chashima|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]] to steal a sample of [[Commbuzzer]], a new bioweapon developed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper caste|shapers]] for use against the Galactic Alliance. Sandskimmer and Ekwesh were able to infiltrate the shapers' compound and escaped with the weapon. However, they were soon pursued by three Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]], and Sandskimmer was struck by a [[Nang hul|thud bug]] thrown by one of the warriors. Forced to protect his companion, Ekwesh confronted the warriors and was grievously injured by one of the [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong warrior (Voort saBinring victim)|warriors']] [[amphistaff]], while Sandskimmer was impaled through the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] by the [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong warrior (Hohass Ekwesh victim)|youngest]] warrior, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. Covering the two Wraiths from afar with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], saBinring killed the two older warriors, while Ekwesh killed the youngest one with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|Those bugs wouldn't have turned the tide of the war.''"<br />"''Maybe not. But they could have led to the discovery and elimination of countless resistance and insurgency cells, countless commando and intelligence units. How many men and women would have died? A thousand? Just two hundred? Piggy, tell me that Runt or Estoric would stand in front of me and say, ''I won't die for just a hundred men, I don't want to go.''|Voort saBinring and Garik Loran|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Estoric Sandskimmer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a member of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> he and [[Hohass Ekwesh|Runt]] [[Mission to Chashima|infiltrated]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper caste|shapers']] compound on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]] in order to steal a new bioweapon developed by the Vong, which the invaders planned to use against the Galactic Alliance. The infiltration was successful, and Sandskimmer and Ekwesh escaped the compound with the weapon, but they were soon chased down by Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]], forcing them to fight. Unfortunately, during the confrontation, Sandskimmer was impaled by one of the [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong warrior (Hohass Ekwesh victim)|warrior's]] [[amphistaff]]s and he [[Death/Legends|died]]. Ekwesh also died during the battle, but thanks to the sharpshooting by Wraith [[Voort saBinring|Voort "Piggy" saBinring]], the warriors also perished.<ref name="MK" />

Neither Sandskimmer nor Ekwesh's deaths were in vain though, for they managed to plant explosives that were set to detonate via timers that brought down the shaper compound. Piggy managed to take the Yuuzhan Vong weapon with him before he was caught by further Vong patrols and he made it back successfully to the Galactic Alliance with that weapon before he retired from Wraith Squadron.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Estoric Sandskimmer  was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the  [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
